title: The same requirement over a two-sided released domain is proved, in QF_NRA
note: The positive control for the unboundedness rule: add the lower premise and the verdict becomes available. It is a claim over the WHOLE released interval, not at one point of it, and it is nonlinear — endurance divides by the freed variable — so the script is QF_NRA and the proof stands on a satisfiable-assumptions witness.
